description: Roll out an accessibility enforcement pipeline across a web application's CI/CD system. The enforcement must include: integrate axe-core lint gates into CI (fail the build on critical/serious violations), add component-library guardrails (storybook addon-a11y, shared a11y-aware components), configure a release-block policy (prevent deployment if a11y violations are detected), and establish a remediation backlog for pre-existing violations (grandfather existing issues but block new ones). A rollback plan must exist (disable the a11y gate in CI to unblock an urgent deploy). Risk factors: the a11y gate can block urgent production deploys, false positives can slow development, and grandfathered violations create a two-tier system. Tools available: axe-core, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, storybook addon-a11y, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CI/CD pipeline.
